summary: Georgia tower list places canoochee in Liberty County with elevation 43 and datasheet BR1573; no other source found on its history or the site today.

evidence.supports: List row for canoochee: coordinates, Liberty County, elevation column 43, datasheet BR1573
List says names for towers numbered 73 and above are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: The list's Google map is marked as revised on 22 March 2016

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list supports this record. Two WebSearch queries (Canoochee fire tower and Liberty County or Hinesville) found no source on this tower. The datasheet BR1573 named in the row was not opened. A Vanishing Georgia photo of the Canoochee River at Landing 5 (dlg_vang_lib018, 1958 or 1959, described as presently Fort Stewart property) is at a different point on the river and its description does not mention a tower, so it was not used. The list gives elevation with no unit. The story is about 85 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because no second source was found. Nothing found describes the site today or public access. No photos.
